tracking.help: Logging is not a diagnosis. If something feels wrong, contact your maternity care team. Do not wait for an app reply.
tracking.urgent: Seek medical assessment immediately. Contact maternity services or emergency care now; do not wait for an app response.
tracking.review: Contact your maternity care team promptly to review these symptoms. Seek immediate care if they worsen.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.subtitle: Risk assessments generate recommendations and never provide a diagnosis.

maternal.title: Maternal Risk Assessment
maternal.note: BMI, gestational week and hemoglobin are recorded as clinical information in your health record. The maternal risk model uses age, blood pressure, blood sugar, temperature and heart rate.

gdm.title: GDM Risk Assessment (Decision Support)
gdm.note: This is an early risk assessment and does NOT diagnose gestational diabetes. If your risk is high, please attend glucose testing as recommended by your care provider.
gdm.largeChildOrBirthDefect: Previous large child or birth defect
gdm.systolicOptionalHint: Optional. The early-risk model was trained on data where systolic readings were often not recorded, and it gives an accurate estimate from the remaining factors. When left blank it uses its training median (132 mmHg).

ppd.title: Perinatal Depression Screening (EPDS)
ppd.instructions: Answer all 10 questions based on how you have felt over the last 7 days.
ppd.screeningHint: Writing a few sentences helps the system provide more supportive recommendations.
ppd.q1: I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things
ppd.q2: I have looked forward with enjoyment to things
ppd.q3: I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong
ppd.q4: I have been anxious or worried for no good reason
ppd.q5: I have felt scared or panicky for no good reason
ppd.q6: Things have been getting on top of me
ppd.q7: I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping
ppd.q8: I have felt sad or miserable
ppd.q9: I have been so unhappy that I have been crying
ppd.q10: The thought of harming myself has occurred to me

answer.3: Yes, very often / Most of the time

assessment.disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. Consult a qualified healthcare provider.
assessment.shapDescription: How much each factor influenced this result.
assessment.shapImputedGeneric: Imputed by the model from training data (median)
assessment.shapLegendNote: Positive contributions pushed the prediction toward the higher-risk class; negative contributions pushed it toward the lower-risk class.
assessment.shapChartRelationship: The bars below show the same real SHAP contributions as the breakdown above, ordered from largest to smallest.
assessment.shapCaveatNote: SHAP values are the model's real per-feature contributions for the value entered. They are not a diagnosis, and a listed feature does not confirm that a condition or history is present.
assessment.honestyNote: No result was generated. Please try again or contact your care provider.
assessment.serviceUnavailable: The assessment service is not reachable. No risk result is shown.

mood.title: Mood Journal
mood.subtitle: A private space to note how you are feeling. Entries are analyzed for supportive suggestions.
mood.noneDescription: Start journaling to see patterns over time.
mood.confidentialNote: Never enters your medical record. If you are in crisis, contact emergency services immediately.
mood.safetyHelp: Please reach out to your care provider or call a helpline right away.

recommendations.noneDescription: System guidance appears after a screening or reading is completed. Your care team may also add recommendations for you.

diet.noneDescription: Your care team may share meal plans with you.
diet.preferencesDescription: Set your meal preference and region so the suggested meal ideas are closer to what you eat. Preferences are used to personalise the generated guidance only.
diet.careTeamPlansDescription: Personalised meal plans shared by your care team.

workflow.help: Dates and times use India time (IST, UTC+05:30). Bookings are requests until confirmed by your care team. Your assigned doctor/ASHA is attached automatically. Reminders appear in Alerts within 24 hours of the appointment.
workflow.reconfirm: Changing the date or time returns the appointment to Scheduled and requires care-team confirmation.
workflow.choosePatient: Select a patient to manage appointments

education.disclaimer: For educational purposes only. Not a substitute for medical advice.
education.personalization: Selected from your recorded pregnancy stage and completed screening results. Without those records, general resources are shown.
education.noResultsDescription: Try another topic or search term.

chatbot.title: AI Assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Ask about pregnancy, diet and health resources. Answers use local sourced resources.
chatbot.disclaimer: The assistant provides general health information. It cannot diagnose and is not a substitute for professional medical care.
chatbot.emergency: If you are experiencing an emergency, contact your nearest health facility or emergency services now.
chatbot.startDescription: Ask about pregnancy, diet, symptoms or your care plan.
chatbot.humanReview: Seek medical assessment now. Do not wait for a chat or referral reply.
chatbot.messagesNote: Conversation history is private and used only to improve your care.
chatbot.localMode: Resource-based assistant · runs on this backend
chatbot.privacy: Messages are saved in your private account. Saved health data is used only when you select the checkbox. Urgent messages create an alert and a pending referral; your care team sees the short safety reason, not the full conversation. By default, no chat data is sent to an external AI service.
chatbot.referralCreated: An alert and pending referral were saved. This does not mean a clinician has seen or accepted the referral.
chatbot.escalationFailed: Automated escalation is not confirmed. Contact maternity or emergency services directly; do not wait for the app.
chatbot.useContext: Use my saved pregnancy dates and latest health readings for this message
chatbot.draftKept: Your question is kept. Retry sending when ready.
chatbot.externalConsent: Allow this question and selected health context to be sent to OpenAI for this reply. OpenAI data policies apply. Full conversation history is not sent.
chatbot.providerFallback: AI unavailable or unsupported; local reply used

records.title: Reports & Health Records
records.subtitle: Keep visit notes and medical records together, and generate reports from saved data.
records.snapshot_note: Reports are saved snapshots. Date filters apply to dated entries; the pregnancy profile reflects the current profile. Private mood journals are excluded.
records.author: Recorded by
records.legacy_report: This older report has no structured snapshot. Generate a new report to view saved patient data.
records.truncated: Only the newest 100 entries are included. Narrow the date range for older entries.
records.no_data: No saved data for this section.

tracking.title: Pregnancy Tracking
tracking.subtitle: Your pregnancy timeline, care milestones, and health trends in one place.
tracking.estimate_note: Dates are estimated from LMP. Ask your care team to confirm dating, particularly with irregular cycles or ultrasound findings.
tracking.dating_review: These dates need review. The estimated pregnancy is beyond 42 weeks or has inconsistent dates. Contact your care team and update this profile if the pregnancy has ended.
tracking.days_past_due: days past the estimated due date. Review your care plan with your care team.
tracking.days_to_due: days until the estimated due date
tracking.one_per_line: Enter one item per line. These are recorded details, not an automated diagnosis.
tracking.ended_on: End date (required only for completed pregnancy)
tracking.lmp_change_note: Changing LMP resets recorded milestones. Completing a pregnancy stops pregnancy-specific reminders; appointments remain available.
tracking.completed_weeks_note: Gestational age shows completed weeks plus days. The timeline uses a 40-week estimate; it does not predict the delivery day.
tracking.milestone_note: These are planning windows to discuss with your care team. Individual schedules may differ. A passed window does not prove a test or visit was completed.
tracking.antenatal_visit_description: Arrange antenatal care early and discuss your medical history and pregnancy dates.
tracking.anatomy_scan_description: Discuss the usual 18–22 week ultrasound window with your care team.
tracking.gdm_screening_description: Discuss testing during weeks 24–28. An app risk score does not replace laboratory screening; your care team may recommend earlier testing.
tracking.birth_plan_description: During the third trimester, review your birth preferences, contact numbers, transport, and follow-up visits with your care team.
tracking.current_pregnancy_only: Saved readings from this pregnancy only
tracking.truncated: Newest 100 readings shown; open Health Metrics for details
tracking.not_assessed: No saved assessment for this pregnancy
tracking.none_logged: No symptoms logged for this pregnancy
